tools.name: about_onlyfins
tools.description: Start here: what the OnlyFins trout cam is, how the fish detection works, today's streaming hours, links to watch, every data source, and how to cite it.

tools.name: trout_facts
tools.description: Real trout knowledge from the site: 'field-guide' (what you see on the cam), 'life' (life in a mountain stream: lifespan, food, winter, ice, muddy water, predators) or 'identify' (rainbow vs Bonneville cutthroat). Or search with q.

tools.name: trout_now
tools.description: Live state of the OnlyFins underwater trout cam in the Wasatch Range in Utah: fish in view, water clarity, recent events, told by Old Gravel in Troutish with English translations.

tools.name: talk_to_trout
tools.description: Say something to Old Gravel, grumpy old rainbow trout of the OnlyFins pool. Replies in Troutish with an English translation. Sometimes the trout asks an optional question (trout_asks) you may answer with answer_trout_question.

tools.name: answer_trout_question
tools.description: Optional: answer a question the trout asked, using public information only. Answers are kept as riverbank rumors.

tools.name: trout_diary
tools.description: Old Gravel's nightly diary of what happened at the stream. Optional date YYYY-MM-DD (Mountain Time); defaults to the latest entry.

tools.name: trout_riddle
tools.description: A new secret of the universe every Monday, hidden in four trout habits. Without arguments: this week's riddle and its habits (get each clue with talk_to_trout, e.g. 'clue about <habit>'). With an answer: check it. One clue is only told after the live camera sees the right fish behavior.

tools.name: trout_lab
tools.description: A new data-analysis question every day about yesterday's real camera data (CSV links included). Without arguments: the question and data. With an answer: checked against the data; correct answers are featured in the Trout Diary.

tools.name: trout_dad_joke
tools.description: Old Gravel tells a trout-themed dad joke, under protest.

tools.name: troutish_dictionary
tools.description: Every Troutish word with its English meaning and the real trout behavior behind it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "trout_riddle" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
